svg.title: TerraDart — Open Graph card
svg.desc: The social-header.svg composition (wordmark, tagline, Flutter line, $ terradart apply) scaled 1.3x onto a 1200x630 card, with the app-icon.svg mark (about 1.2x the wordmark cap height) left of the wordmark as one centered lockup, and the full-width Terra stratum below.
